title: Implement the todo web app
instructions: Implement make_app in app.py so that every test in test_app.py passes. Follow the module docstring exactly: routes, status codes, headers and HTML structure. Use only the Python standard library (wsgiref, json, html, urllib.parse and so on). Do not edit test_app.py.
acceptance_why: A browser form and a JSON client must both work, invalid input must never create todos, titles must be HTML-escaped, and every route must answer with the documented status and headers.
